title: Generator output voltage
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the effective output voltage of the generator as 1100 V.

title: Transformer turns ratio
description: Essential: The student must correctly determine the primary-to-secondary turns ratio as 5:1.

title: Primary coil current
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the ammeter reading (primary coil current) as 20 A.

title: Apply generator EMF formula
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the formula for the maximum EMF (E_m = NBSω) and relate it to the effective voltage.

title: Apply transformer voltage ratio
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the ideal transformer voltage ratio (U1/U2 = n1/n2) using the generator voltage and the motor operating voltage.

title: Apply power conservation
description: Important: The student must recognize and apply power conservation for the ideal transformer (P_in = P_out), where the output power is the total power of the two motors.

title: Relate power, voltage, current
description: Important: The student must correctly use the relationship P = UI to find the primary coil current from the primary voltage and input power.

title: Confuse peak and RMS voltage
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses the peak generator EMF as the output voltage without dividing by √2.

title: Incorrect motor total power
description: Pitfall: The student uses the power of a single motor (11 kW) instead of the total power for both motors (22 kW) in power conservation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student demonstrates unit analysis for angular frequency, EMF, or power calculations.
